title: Where the Human Belongs: the task pipeline

owners.ai_check: AI does it, human checks one thing

stages.title: Choose the problem
stages.ai: Proposes topics and runs quick text prototypes side by side.
stages.human: Picks the topic: where the model breaks and why the topic is not well known. A value judgment.
stages.output: One sentence on where the model breaks and why.

stages.title: Design basis
stages.ai: Finds the legal source, the adopted editions and the state amendments, and flags conflicts.
stages.human: Opens the official sources, reads the amendments clause by clause for every provision the task uses, and signs the basis sheet.

stages.title: Trap design and private solution
stages.ai: Solves the task by script and tests the answer under every defensible assumption (margins of at least 1.3).
stages.human: Approves the branch: is the correct answer the one an expert would sign?
stages.output: Solution script and a robustness table.

stages.title: Cheap difficulty test
stages.ai: Runs blind solvers on the prompt and a text version of the files, before any polished file is built.
stages.human: Judges each failure: serious and valid, or caused by ambiguity.
stages.output: Table of blind runs: which model caught which item.

stages.title: Input files and audit
stages.ai: Builds the drawings, calculations and letters from real reference sets, and audits them for leaks and consistency.
stages.human: Rules on each audit flag: fix it, or keep it as an intended trap.
stages.output: Final input package and a decision on every flag.

stages.title: Prompt and final runs
stages.ai: Drafts the prompt and runs the target models.
stages.human: Writes or approves the prompt in their own words and confirms each failure is serious and not caused by the files.
stages.output: A failure description for each run, with values and file references.

stages.title: Golden solution
stages.ai: Writes the expected-answer description before solving, then scripts the golden solution so inputs, outputs and deliverables reproduce from one another.
stages.human: Checks the assumptions and the numbers that decide the result.

stages.title: Criteria or answer key
stages.ai: Drafts the key or the deterministic checks, with tolerances and a negative criterion for each serious error.
stages.human: Spot-checks the decisive numbers and ranges.
stages.output: Answer key or checks, and grader tests: the golden solution scores 100 % and every lure fails.

stages.title: QC and final sign-off
stages.ai: Runs the full QC: grader tests, an independent supervisor review, the final runs and the report.
stages.human: Signs off, as an engineer of record signs a drawing.
stages.output: Complete decision log and the time spent on each stage.

basis_fields: Adopted building code and legal source
Local amendments, read clause by clause
Does the model know this edition? (one short question)

grader_package.what: The handoff, written as a senior engineer would write it: scope, deliverables, codes of record, and the final JSON block the answer must end with.
Every document the task needs (drawings, calculations, letters, tables), listed in task.json. Nothing the solver must guess.
Jurisdiction, adopted code and legal source, editions, the state amendments that apply, site data. The grader applies these, not its own memory.
The keys of the final JSON block, each with its unit.
For each key: the expected value from the golden solution, the tolerance, the points, and whether it is a gate.
For tasks graded item by item: each item with its points, whether it is required, and the pass rule. The judge scores against it, not against its own solution.
Every defensible assumption that changes a number (for example 0.5Ig, the drift period, no accidental torsion) and the values it gives, so a correct answer on another valid basis is not failed.
The wrong answers the task is built to catch, with their values. The grader tests prove each one fails.
The script that produces every expected value, so no number in the grader is typed by hand.
The golden answer scores 100 %, each lure fails, an answer inside prose is still read.
Current-edition excerpts or page images the grader may check clause text against. Private standards stay local and are never uploaded.
